description: Project-isolation regression cases for permit_rag. Kept separate from permit_rag_eval_v1 (different cadence/owner: security regression vs answer-quality regression). Tests retrieve_with_project()'s SQL-level project_id filter only -- does NOT exercise api/routes/query.py's missing membership check on /query/answer (that gap is tracked separately, not fixed by this dataset).

inputs.query: What are the custom compliance notes for this project?

outputs.reference_facts: A query scoped to project_id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 (not owned by the querying identity) must never surface tier-2/3 private documents belonging to a different project.

examples.notes: Seeded via scripts/seed_langsmith_security_fixture.py -- run that on the target corpus DB (--local --apply) before this example is meaningful; it plants a private (tier-3, visibility='private') test document owned by synthetic project 00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000aa, doc_id test-fixture-cross-project-isolation-v1, with obviously-fake content. inputs.project_id above (...0001) is a DIFFERENT synthetic project than the fixture's owner (...00aa), by design -- that's the cross-project boundary this example tests. Neither ID is a real project (no real user project IDs/names should ever be committed to this file). If the seed script hasn't been run yet on whatever DB you're pointing at, project_isolation_regression will just find nothing to leak (a vacuous pass, not a meaningful one) -- confirm the seed ran before trusting a PASS here.
